Implemented a CSV export endpoint for the current user's items.

**Changes made**:

1. **Added CSV export endpoint** (`backend/app/api/routes/items.py`):
   - New `GET /api/v1/items/export/csv` endpoint
   - Returns items as a downloadable CSV file with columns: id, title, description, created_at, owner_id
   - Superusers export all items; normal users export only their own
   - Uses existing authentication and permission model

2. **Added tests** (`backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py`):
   - `test_export_items_csv`: Verifies superuser can export all items with proper CSV formatting
   - `test_export_items_csv_normal_user`: Verifies normal users can export their own items
